scientific_question: Is the failed hard top-1 result caused by straight-through assignment instability rather than insufficient capacity in the exact same four-expert family?

causal_basis.parent_finding: Soft joint fitting reduces the normalized value-plus-direction objective by 79.4 percent to 0.8187, but hard conversion raises the objective above 3 and straight-through training reduces it only 7.6 percent. The parent is optimization-inconclusive by its frozen rule.
causal_basis.authorized_repair: The parent plan permits only offline optimizer-geometry repair of this exact family. Alternating assignment, expert fitting, and router classification changes no representation, parameter count, checkpoint identity, dataset bank, functional gate, or LM state.
causal_basis.not_a_sweep: One deterministic six-cycle path is frozen. There is no choice of expert count, top-k, router architecture, temperature, optimizer, seed, or result-selected restart.

family.representation: Identical DepthSharedTop1MLP from the parent: four full-width experts, one active expert per token, per-layer affine router, pre-GELU gain, and residual-output gain.

repair_protocol.assignment: At the start of each cycle, assign every discovery-bank layer/bank/row to the expert minimizing the sum of separately normalized clean-output error and central-difference direction error. Ties select the lowest expert index. Targets are used only for this offline ceiling assignment.

expert_m_step.trainable: expert matrices, layer pre-GELU gains, and residual-output gains; router frozen
expert_m_step.objective: The registered equal-weight normalized clean-value plus central-difference direction loss, evaluated only through each sample's frozen assigned expert.

router_m_step.trainable: the unchanged layer-specific affine router only
router_m_step.objective: Cross entropy from layer-normalized clean inputs to the frozen oracle expert assignments.

repair_protocol.best_state_rule: After every complete E/M cycle, evaluate the hard routed discovery objective and preserve the smallest one. Holdout metrics never select a cycle or state.

report: oracle assignment occupancy and change rate per cycle
router discovery and holdout assignment accuracy
oracle-assigned and router-routed discovery/holdout value-direction objectives
hard routed output and analytic input-JVP recovery by layer/bank
wall time and peak CUDA memory

frozen_gates.optimization_healthy: Finite execution plus at least 25-percent reduction in the best hard-routed discovery objective versus the parent hard-top1 initial objective 3.7679713517427444.

decision_rule.pass: The four-expert representation is sufficient and the straight-through optimizer was the blocker. Implement and exact-config MFU-gate only a 124M/0.5TPP LM verification.
decision_rule.oracle_good_router_bad: If oracle-assigned holdout output/JVP gates pass but routed gates fail, close the affine router and derive one richer router from the measured assignment boundary; do not add experts.
decision_rule.healthy_fail: Reject the exact four-expert top-1 family and do not sweep its optimizer or expert count. Move to a finer complete-atom allocation or locally generated full-width field.
decision_rule.optimization_inconclusive: Stop and report; do not launch LM training or infer a capacity result.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run this exact zero-LM-update hard-EM repair after focused tests and measured preflight.
not_allowed: language-model training before all routed functional gates pass
expert-count, top-k, router, cycle-count, optimizer, learning-rate, seed, activation, or regularizer sweeps
using holdout data to change assignments or select state
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll if the measured complete protocol is at most five minutes; otherwise use one verified terminal/failure @Codex watchdog.
